lines.trans: This is Baek Seung-chan, our brand-new rookie producer who just joined the station!
Oh, do you sing as well? I always thought you were strictly an actor.
Because my mother is such a huge fan of yours.
What on earth are you saying—he originally debuted as a singer and has massive hit songs!
My absolute favorite song of his—Because Noona Is My Woman!
The song title is not Because Noona Is My Woman—it is Because You Are My Woman.

words.gloss: is Because You Are My Woman

lines.trans: When I get married I definitely want that wedding song—Will You Marry With Me!
The title is simply Will You Marry Me—without the With Me part.
Why does a tiny detail like that even matter!
I am grabbing a coffee—get Cindy ready on the stage lift, got it?

meanings.en: to do, to perform, to hold

examples.trans: What are you doing right now?

meanings.note: Primary meaning.
Idiomatic in 시험을 보다.

examples.trans: I watched a movie on the weekend.
I took the driver's license exam.

meanings.note: Humble first-person singular pronoun used in polite speech.

meanings.note: When used with 알다/모르다, it means knowing or not knowing a fact or how to do something.

examples.trans: I knew it would rain.

meanings.note: ㄹ-irregular verb: stem 알- drops ㄹ before ㄴ, ㅂ, ㅅ (e.g., 압니까)

examples.trans: Do you know that person's phone number?

meanings.note: Humble 1st person plural pronoun used when speaking to superiors or in formal settings.

meanings.note: Polite, respectful word for mother (compared to 엄마, mom).

meanings.note: Used colloquially for positive or negative emphasis.

examples.trans: The weather is so nice today.

meanings.note: Used only with close friends, younger people, or children

audible sound made by people or things

related.gloss: to not exist, to not have

meanings.note: Plain first-person singular pronoun used with friends, younger people, or subordinates; contracts to 난 with -는 and becomes 내가 before -가.

examples.trans: I'm going to stay home today.

meanings.note: superlative adverb placed before an adjective or adverb

examples.text: 한국 음식 중에서 비빔밥을 제일 좋아해요.
examples.trans: Among Korean foods, I like bibimbap the most.

meanings.en: older sister; older female friend or senior
meanings.note: Used by a younger male speaker.

examples.trans: I have one older sister.
Nuna, do you have time today?
Did you hear about this female?
I was busy today because of female.

meanings.note: Used in spoken Korean dialogue (noun).

meanings.en: to come (of a feeling, state, or weather)
